summary: Complete, production-ready implementation plan and code specification for the Node.js Express backend server (server.js) and Supabase database architecture script. Includes exact endpoints (/api/create-pending-ticket, /api/ticket-status/:ref, /api/sms-listener), Android SMS forwarder regex parsing for MTN MoMo and Airtel Money, qrcode generation, and nodemailer inline CID email dispatch.
